response.sql: SELECT f.orderslink, o.mktnote AS trading_pair, AVG(f.rebrate) AS avg_rebate_rate, SUM(f.rebtotal) AS total_rebate FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY total_rebate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff is inclusive, so 'high-rate' fees are those with feerate >= 0.0009. The inner join drops fees with no matching order, and AVG and SUM skip NULL rebrate and rebtotal values. A group whose rebtotal values are all NULL returns a NULL total and sorts last.

alternatives.interpretation: 'High-rate' means strictly above the cutoff, so feerate must be greater than 0.0009.
